scientific.integrity: The motivating open full text was inspected at the SIAQR equations, existence/uniqueness setup, the complete component recurrences (5.18)--(5.22), and the simulation conclusions. A prior SIAQR paper was checked for state-space context, and an independent later exposition of Newton-polynomial Caputo stepping was inspected at its scalar history formula. The bundled high-precision checker replays the exact fractional conservation witness. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result concerns the recurrence printed in equation (5.22). The simulation code is unavailable and may have used the intended recovered-state arguments. The result does not assess the full convergence, stability, or positivity theory of the underlying Newton-polynomial fractional method.

title: The printed fractional SIAQR recovery update breaks exact population conservation
